findings.body:
**An injected `deps.observationWriter` conflicts with the run's own identities.**

`compositionRunId` (Line 296) and `correlation.workId` (Line 247) are allocated before the writer is chosen. When `deps.observationWriter` is supplied, the writer keeps its own `compositionRunId` and `workId`.

The writer contract in `src/kernel/observation.ts:85-121` says an adopting composition takes both identities from the writer.

The `append` checks reject the header in two cases:
- `event.runId` differs from the writer's `compositionRunId`.
- `correlation.workId` differs from the writer's `workId`.

`observationFailure` then marks the stream `indeterminate`. Every later append through `bindings.observationRunId` fails the same way. The memory-only fixtures this seam exists for will therefore always report `indeterminate`.

Take both identities from the writer. This does not change the path where the composition opens its own writer.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-    const compositionRunId = randomUUID();
+    const compositionRunId = deps.observationWriter?.compositionRunId ?? randomUUID();
```

```diff
-      const { provenance, correlation } = await captureProvenance(
+      const captured = await captureProvenance(
         repoRoot,
         runPrefix,
         new Date(start).toISOString(),
         config.base,
         configText,
       );
+      const { provenance } = captured;
+      const correlation = {
+        ...captured.correlation,
+        workId: deps.observationWriter?.workId ?? captured.correlation.workId,
+      };
```
</details>
findings.title: An injected `deps.observationWriter` conflicts with the run's own identities.

findings.body:
**Fold `observationFailures` into the observation status.**

`SweepUnitReport.observationFailures` records attempt-observation failures that do not reach the writer. Fold these failures before `closeObservation()` so the report does not retain `status: 'durable'` or `'unavailable'` when observation evidence is incomplete.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
+      for (const unit of collected.values())
+        for (const failure of unit.observationFailures ?? []) observationFailure(failure);
       await closeObservation();
```

</details>
findings.title: Fold `observationFailures` into the observation status.
Handle descriptor read failures as observation failures.
